what: Worlds → Cartridges: click the aether-land 1.2.0 row (installed on every device by base.ts). The click focuses and confirms the row at once, so it starts a run pinned to 1.2.0 (the recorded 'Play' click found nothing and is dropped here); the land opens and its local-only history is made (genesis on 1.2.0); wait for the origin witness

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return JSON.stringify({ screen: s.screen, pin: s.activeInstance.instance?.runtimePin ?? null }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout ' + S.useSessionStore.getState().screen })()

repeat.until: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return n !== null && n.chunks['0,0'] !== undefined })()

actions.eval: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return JSON.stringify({ world: n?.world, head: n?.head, cartridge: n?.genesis?.body?.cartridge ?? null, physics: n?.genesis?.body?.physicsVersion ?? null, sequencer: n?.sequencer ?? null, chunks: n && Object.keys(n.chunks) }) })()
